name: vt-a-rest
caption: At rest: nothing on the stage, the Start button inside its quiet ring at the bottom centre.

name: vt-a-starting
caption: Starting own speech: the machine phases listed beside the spinning ring as they progress, each finished one ticked with its time; the engine named to their right, set off by a rule.

name: vt-a-starting-fetch
caption: A start after a change: 'starting machine' and 'updating speech server' ticked with their times, 'fetching model qwen3-asr-0.6b' in progress.

name: vt-a-hearing
caption: Hearing: the mock-up is on the stage and the person's words arrive in the caption strip as they are heard, the ring tracing the mic.

name: vt-a-thinking
caption: Thinking: the person's sentence is final, a turn is in flight, the ring pulses quietly and the status says thinking.

name: vt-a-speaking
caption: Speaking: the agent replies over the architecture diagram, the ring tracing its voice, the node it talks about lit, and a proposal card slid in at the right edge.

name: vt-a-visual-mockup
caption: A UI mock-up frame fills the stage with two note pins; one note is open from its pin.

name: vt-a-visual-code
caption: A code slice in focus; the agent points at line 42 while it speaks, the line banded in the accent.

name: vt-a-note-adding
caption: Adding a note: a region dragged on the mock-up, and the note the person just spoke lands on its new pin.

name: vt-a-readback-pending
caption: A read-back waiting: Heard, Will cancel: run nightly-e2e #482, Go and Not that, with the 45-second clock as a small ring.

name: vt-a-readback-confirmed
caption: Confirmed by voice: the person said 'go ahead', the card ticks Go in green and quotes the words, no click.

name: vt-a-readback-refused
caption: Refused: the person said 'no', the card marks Not that and quotes the word before it slides out; the agent says it left the run alone.

name: vt-a-readback-expired
caption: Expired: no answer within 45 seconds, nothing ran; the card greys, shows 0s and 'expired', and stays for the record.

name: vt-a-reconnecting
caption: Reconnecting: the speech server's socket dropped; the ring spins in the warning colour, Mute and Push to talk are held, Stop stays live.

name: vt-a-engine-down
caption: Engine down: the speech server did not come back, the machine stopped and the session goes on in text mode: a field, Send and Stop where the ring was, the engine now 'this browser'.

name: vt-a-no-l4
caption: No L4 free at Start: the one line with its Text control, and the session in text mode from the first second: a field, Send and Stop, nothing spent.

name: vt-a-budget-80
caption: Budget at 80%: the budget line at the top right turns to the warning colour and grows.

name: vt-a-budget-cap
caption: Budget at the cap: the session has ended and the machine stopped; the budget line is red at $100.00, the ring is back to Start and the status says 'budget cap' (the reason in its tooltip).

name: vt-a-gptlive
caption: The same page on GPT-Live: the engine tick says GPT-Live and there are no machine states.

name: vt-a-hearing-390
caption: Phone, hearing: the mock-up keeps its text at 12 px and pans in a square window opened on the part being talked about, the captions below, the ring at the bottom.
